note: Checks read the FINAL placed solids of cad/paddle_launcher_constrained.py, never the inputs that produced them.  Targets come from the requirements and config/t06_vendor_derivation.json (which measures the official goBILDA STEP), never from the part under test.  Volume is compared as the sum of the part's own solids, which is invariant under the -ANGLE placement rotation; bounding-box checks are only requested on parts whose datum axis survives that rotation (the launcher's drive axis is Y, so Y extents are rotation-invariant and discs keep their sorted envelope).  DEC-0021: a purchased part is the whole official file, so a supplier part modelled with real internal air keeps its own body count.

not_verified: Pollen and nectar foam game-piece solids are deliberately absent from this model (see cad/paddle_launcher_constrained.py), so no check here covers the projectile.
Purchased-part internal fits (press fits, bearing preload, gear backlash) are not measurable from the single combined part and are not claimed.
The -ANGLE rotation means only non-disc parts keep a rotation-invariant bounding box; quantities that would need an unrotated frame are checked by summed volume instead.
